text:
emma_cs: Aurora onboarding - customer reports spikes of 429 when they spin up many short-lived workers for chat. started after they switched to per-invocation auth. attaching small excerpts.

emma_cs: logs: 
```
2026-04-10T08:02:11Z INFO req=c1 POST /v1/chat 200 time=98ms
2026-04-10T08:02:11Z WARN req=c2 POST /v1/chat 429 time=19ms x-rate-limit-remaining=0
2026-04-10T08:02:12Z INFO req=c3 POST /v1/chat 200 time=105ms
```

emma_cs: their auth returns {"token":"...","ttl":20}. code snippet: 
```
# handler
token = requests.post('https://auth.aurora.app/mint').json()['token']
requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'}, json=payload)
```

kai_se: ephemeral token-per-call + no connection reuse = auth stampede. quick remediation: 1) cache token in-process for ttl-5s 2) reuse HTTP session / enable keep-alive 3) add small randomized startup delay on warmers.

kai_se: tiny python patch: 
```
_session = requests.Session(); _cache={'t':None,'e':0}
def get_token():
  if time.time() < _cache['e'] - 5: return _cache['t']
  r = requests.post('https://auth.aurora.app/mint'); d=r.json(); _cache.update({'t':d['token'],'e':time.time()+d['ttl']}); return _cache['t']
# use _session.post(..., headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {get_token()}'})
```

sam_support: I'll ask them to rollout as a 10% canary and monitor 429 rate and x-rate-limit-remaining. can ops open a short mitigation window to soften hard 429s while they patch?

ops_bot: mitigation ticket #CS-5320 created, owner=kai_se, expires_in=20m, playbook=token-cache-grace

emma_cs: staging test: cache + session reduced 429s from 5.8% -> 0.3% within 10m. customer will canary in prod.

kai_se: also recommend client-side retry on 429 with exponential backoff and jitter (avoid immediate retry). we should add an internal KB entry for per-invocation-token anti-pattern.

sam_support: customer asked if we can emit a gateway header hinting at auth pressure so their SRE can alert. capture for product feedback/renewal note.

kai_se: we can prototype `x-token-pressure: hotspot` when we detect >60 auth checks/min from a tenant origin. filing small spike task.

emma_cs: prod canary started, monitoring dashboard looks stable so far. will update in 30m. thanks all :thumbsup:
